scope: Analytic fit-deviation compatibility with hidden source triangles
method: Read the dirty main and candidate handlers and GUI calls; compare whitespace-normalized deviation function text; run a finite shared-function counterexample. The old handler applies deviations to all source positions. The candidate invokes inspectDeviationAsync, which masks hidden samples.
status: Open compatibility regression: an existing main GUI and MCP input yields different artifact values and statistics for hidden geometry. Resolve with a shared, discoverable scope and explicitly reconcile defaults and retained visible-only inspection behavior before calling integration complete.
limitations: The counterexample tests shared functions and source inspection, not a live cross-check between two running public MCP servers.
Do not treat the expected failure as a passing compatibility test or a decision to discard visible-only inspection behavior.
